title: Firefly Aerospace vs. SpaceX: Which Space Stock Can Put Your Portfolio Into Orbit in 2026?
author: Brendan Coffey
description: The article compares Firefly Aerospace and SpaceX as investment opportunities in 2026. Firefly offers a cheaper valuation with a $1.4B backlog and government contracts, while SpaceX dominates with its Starlink constellation and reusable rockets. Despite SpaceX's massive scale and IPO success, the author favors Firefly's more focused business model and lower price-to-sales ratio for long-term investors.

However, faces legal risks and significant operational losses.

title: Bloom Energy vs. Eos Energy Enterprises: Which Energy Storage Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
author: Brendan Coffey
description: The article compares two energy storage companies: Bloom Energy, a mature fuel cell provider with strong partnerships and profitability, and Eos Energy Enterprises, an emerging zinc-based battery manufacturer with explosive revenue growth but significant losses. Despite Bloom's higher valuation multiples, Eos is recommended for its attractive P/S ratio, recent business advances, and strong 2026 pipeline, while Bloom benefits from the AI datacenter boom with expected 85% revenue growth.

title: Wall Street Loves This EV Stock. Here's Why I'm Not Buying.
author: Ryan Vanzo
description: As the EV industry shifts toward robotaxi operations expected to reach scale by 2030, Lucid Group faces significant competitive disadvantages. Unlike Tesla and Rivian, Lucid lacks affordable vehicle models and sufficient production capacity to achieve economies of scale needed to supply robotaxi operators. This structural weakness makes it an unattractive investment despite Wall Street analyst support.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Lacks affordable models, has insufficient production capacity compared to competitors, and is structurally disadvantaged in supplying the emerging robotaxi market despite existing partnerships.
Can manufacture vehicles cheaply for its own robotaxi operations, already has established production scale, and is well-positioned to dominate the robotaxi market.
Recently launched affordable models under $50,000 and has better production capacity than Lucid, positioning it ahead in supplying the robotaxi industry.
